comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Looking at bulk_status_writer vs single transition path — only the latter attaches old_status to the outbox row.

content.text: Looking at bulk_status_writer vs single transition path — only the latter attaches old_status to the outbox row.

When an issue jumps from To Do straight to Done via a workflow transition that skips In Progress, the issue.updated webhook body sets status to Done but leaves previous_status null (or omits the field). Consumers that drive automations on status deltas cannot tell what the prior state was.

Normal single-step transitions correctly populate previous_status from the transition's from_status_id. Multi-hop or admin "move to" paths load only the destination status into the event builder and never read issues.status before the update commit.

Hypothesis: StatusTransitionEvent is built after the UPDATE, and the skip path uses a bulk status writer that does not pass old_status into the outbox payload. Fix should snapshot status in the same transaction before write, regardless of intermediate skips.
Integrations that gate on leaving In Progress silently no-op for these jumps, which is how the report surfaced.
